name: Laura Repaci
headline: Vice President, Global Professional Services | Skillsoft | The Global Leader in Corporate Learning
about:
Global Professional Services executive with 20+ years of experience scaling high-performing organizations, driving transformation, and delivering measurable business impact in complex B2B environments.

I specialize in building and leading global delivery teams that accelerate revenue growth, increase customer lifetime value, and strengthen enterprise client relationships. By aligning operational excellence with corporate strategy, I consistently deliver results that improve profitability, elevate customer satisfaction, and reduce churn.

Over the past five years, I have led a services organization through sustained double-digit growth, expanding the team from 75 to 150+ professionals while scaling delivery capabilities globally. In the most recent fiscal year, we delivered over $25M in services revenue and achieved an average CSAT score of 4.7/5 — reflecting a disciplined focus on quality, execution, and customer value realization.

As the executive leader of Professional Services at Skillsoft, I am accountable for global service delivery strategy, operational performance, revenue attainment, talent development, and cross-functional alignment with Sales, Product, and Customer Success. Our organization partners with enterprise clients to ensure successful adoption, measurable outcomes, and long-term value realization.

My leadership philosophy is simple:
• Build scalable, data-driven operating models
• Develop strong, accountable leaders at every level
• Tie service delivery directly to business outcomes
• Make success teams a measurable growth engine

Core Areas of Expertise:
Professional Services Leadership | Global Delivery Operations | Business Transformation | Revenue & Margin Optimization | Customer Lifecycle Strategy | Organizational Scaling | Operational Excellence | Program & Portfolio Management | Executive Stakeholder Engagement

I am particularly passionate about transforming organizations into strategic growth engines that not only deliver exceptional customer outcomes but materially impact enterprise valuation.

experiences.description:
Lead the global Professional Services organization accountable for enterprise implementation, solution delivery, customer value realization, and financial performance across Skillsoft’s learning experience platform and content portfolio.

Organizational Scope includes:

- 140+ global professionals across implementation, consulting, and delivery functions
 - $27M annual services revenue
 - 5 consecutive years of signifcant growth
 - 4.7/5 average CSAT

Strategic Impact includes:

 - Business Integration & Transformation
 - Successfully merged two business units into a unified global services organization, standardizing operating models, delivery governance, and performance metrics
 - Built scalable systems and leadership structure to support rapid growth and global expansion
 - Increased services revenue from $21M to $27M while maintaining strong profitability and utilization discipline
 - Sustained ~70% utilization rates while preserving margin integrity
 - Positioned Professional Services as a growth contributor rather than a post-sale support function
 - Elevated Professional Services to the strategic front end of the customer lifecycle
 - Maintained industry-leading customer satisfaction metrics during periods of rapid growth and change

Under my leadership, Professional Services has evolved into a disciplined, high-performing global organization that drives measurable impact across revenue, retention, and enterprise value.

Deciding to move our entire customer base to Skillsoft's latest technology needed to be a finely orchestrated multi-year effort which was,ultimately, executed flawlessly with the perfect combination of technical expertise, program management, and excellent customer skills.  

With direct accounting for program success to our CTO, CRO and CEO, responsible for the migration of 3,500 Skillsoft customers from multiple platform versions to Skillsoft’s most current technologies. This encompassed two unique programs involving product solution development, program redesign and platform re implementation strategies and multiple execution methodologies.

As a result of seven distinct mergers and acquisitions, over 12 years, we were responsible for the migration of over 6,000 customers to Skillsoft’s latest technologies.  

Responsible for Skillsoft’s Sustainable Improvement Program (SSIP) designed to identify inefficiencies, both manual and systematic, that detract from Sales and Support cycles and customer interactions. Work cross-functionally with all departments to enact changes to implement change.

Helped to stand up a branch office in Atlanta from NY based headquarters. Responsible for the management of all Business and Technical Operations for 150+ person branch office.  Reported directly to the SVP of Sales & Operations. Oversight and Management of IT Network and Infrastructure, Telephone and technical equipment. Management of all Pre-Sales functions.  To increase productivity and efficiencies I created mortgage pipeline database tracking system that was adopted and implemented globally to replace manual redundant systems.
Responsible for the oversight of all mortgage processing and accounting operations. Including systems and process redesign and new payroll system implementation.
